derivedAudits.reason: This correctly prevents an automatic eligibility headline/category/sector from replacing the required manual route and certificate review.

derivedAudits.claim: The reservation bar computes an open/General Merit remainder of 43% from the listed vertical shares totalling 57%.

derivedAudits.reason: The denominator is the total State Quota; the named SEBC group shares sum to the separately printed 27% State Quota figure.
